    → unsupported EIR backend feature: sort indexed-array element PHP type Mixed

Nothing exotic is being asked for. `readdir()` answers `string|false`, so the accumulator types as
`array<Mixed>`, and every builtin with a `T|false` return does the same to any loop that collects
it. php sorts such an array without comment, so this was a compile error on working php.

No new sorting was written. `__rt_usort` already permutes 8-byte slots ag
